controls.label: Historical model
controls.description: A historical shape reconstructed from Giotto and Vega images. The grid follows the model; depressions and fine details are uncertain.
controls.title: Stooke nucleus shape reconstruction

controls.label: Giotto
controls.description: Giotto photographed Halley through its dusty coma. This view places a small illuminated patch on the historical nucleus model; the grid marks unmapped terrain. Placement is approximate; the shape alone is uncertain by about 0.5–1 km.
controls.title: Giotto illuminated nucleus composite
